column1: # Coding models are the registry rows the coding lane may name, each joined
# to scripts/models.tsv by model_id and bounded by that row's own validated
# depth. role separates the interactive fast coder from the deep reviewer;
# minimum_validated_depth is the floor the lane requires of the row's
# validated_filled_depth before the model may serve a coding job, so a
# registry edit that lowers the validated depth below the floor removes the
# model from the lane rather than serving it thinner.
